title: 信息日报 2026-08-05

headline.title: OpenClaw 与 Ollama 联合研究：迈向完全自主可扩展的 Agentic AI 系统
headline.summary: 该研究系统分析了 Agentic AI 从反应式大模型向持久化、可行动系统转变中的架构缺口，提出将推理、编排与执行层分离，并整合 OpenClaw 与 Ollama 以构建完全自主、可扩展的智能体系统。论文为自主智能体的工程化提供了分层设计参考。
headline.title_en: OpenClaw and Ollama in Agentic AI: Toward Fully Autonomous and Scalable AI Agent Systems
headline.summary_en: This paper systematically analyzes architectural gaps in the transition from reactive LLMs to persistent, action-capable systems, proposing separation of inference, orchestration, and execution layers, and integrating OpenClaw with Ollama to build fully autonomous, scalable agent systems. It offers a layered design reference for engineering autonomous agents.
headline.original_title: OpenClaw and Ollama in Agentic AI: Toward Fully Autonomous and Scalable AI Agent Systems
headline.reason: 该论文是当日最高分 AI 研究，直接回应 Agentic AI 从原型走向工程化的核心痛点，对开发者社区和产业落地方向具有标杆意义。
headline.reason_en: As the top-scoring AI research of the day, it directly addresses key pain points in moving agentic AI from prototype to engineering, offering a benchmark for developers and industry adoption.
